newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for corn, soybean bids.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for corn, soybean bids.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Wednesday it was extending until 1000 GMT on November 6 the deadline for bids for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. or Argentine yellow corn and 30,000 tonnes of soybeans, any origin. The deadline was previously October 30.

In a clarification of its first announcement, it added that it would consider bids under which the seller would ship the two consignments on separate vessels. The first announcement suggested they had to come on the same vessel.
The consignments are for loading up to November 20 and delivery by December 15. -- Jonathan Wright +20 2 578 3290/1
